prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose or Create Your Companion", "Select an instantly ready companion or create a custom pet tailored to your desktop.", "Instant Presets"]
1: ["Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to interact, hide, and summon your pet on your desktop.", "Right-click your pet to open settings or double-click to hide."]
2: ["Begin Your Adventure", "Pick your pet companion path after reading the story."]
3: ["Your Pet is Arriving!", "Tap the screen to play with your pet preview while we prepare your desktop app.", "Play Mini Game"]
4: ["Signing in syncs your account cloud backup so your adopted desktop pet is never lost."]
5: ["Rendering Desktop Companion", "We are placing your pet on your main desktop monitor.", "Pet missing? Check system tray icon or multi-monitor display settings.", "If pet does not appear, check your system tray menu to unhide it."]
6: ["Choose Your Pet Path", "Each path unlocks exclusive free accessories for your desktop pet.", "Includes free starter accessory bonus upon selection!", "Free Accessory Included"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Your desktop companion is officially registered.", "Confirm Companion"]
8: ["You will receive a notification as soon as your pet settles onto your desktop."]
9: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is active on your screen. Right-click for options or press Ctrl+Shift+P to summon.", "Start Playing", "Right-click to feed | Double-click to hide | Drag to move"]
